text:
I have visited many McDonald's stores in the world, I have not seen such a service, I ordered a Big Mac in the first place, and I felt that I was still hungry, so I ordered a chicken burger, and I was shocked that the chicken was so old that I felt a tickle in my mouth.

And when I asked a lady inside the kitchen that the chicken was too grilled and I couldn't chew it, and in addition to that it was old.  Not only that she was rude because I am a foreigner, but she was even more rude to a Pakistani girl who I think is a Muslim when I asked her for a chicken sandwich without bacon. after i asked her three times that the chicken is too roasted, on the one hand, and old on the other, but she replied that it was chicken.

I informed the manager, and he told me that he would change the burger for me, and I waited about fifteen minutes only to change the burger, the taste of everything had changed and I didn't want to eat.  I took pictures of it.
author: Akram Tahiri

text:
I and my family have visited many McDonald's stores in the world, I have not seen such a service. I ordered 2 sets of McSpicy meal and 3 sets of Mc Chicken meal at around 9:30 for table service.

They served us at about 9:52pm and tell us that they close at 2200.

We continue eating our meal and at 10pm sharp, the staff come and chase us out of the store and tell us that cannot eat inside anymore and not even provide us with the takeaway cup and paper bag for bringing our 2/3 left meal. We have to go take ourselves the takeaway cup to pour out drink into the cup as the serve plastic cup cannot take out of the store.

I would like to ask McDonald what kind of service is this?

In my country (Singapore), if we cannot finish our meal in time if reaches the closure time, the staff will ask you politely to finish your meal as they are closing. They will wait till you finish your meal and not chase you out of the store.
author: Alex Tan

text:
Déception importante au McDonald’s Myeongdong le 24 février 2026

Nous avons passé une commande d’environ 150 €. À la réception des plateaux, près de la moitié des produits manquaient. Nous l’avons signalé à un employé (grand monsieur en chemise blanche). Malheureusement, son attitude a été marquée par de l’agacement visible, des soupirs et des remarques peu professionnelles.

Les éléments manquants nous ont été apportés progressivement après plusieurs demandes. Face à l’inconfort de la situation, nous avons finalement renoncé à récupérer l’intégralité de la commande pour éviter davantage de tensions.

De plus, plusieurs plats étaient froids.

Cette expérience a gâché ce qui devait être notre principal repas de la semaine. Au vu du montant dépensé, nous attendions un service plus rigoureux et respectueux. Nous ne pensons pas revenir.
author: zakaria sallali

text: I can not believe that this was even McDonald's! Worse ever service! I went beginning of April this year around 7.30pm weekday. There was one person serving on the till and the queue was going out the door. I had to wait over 15mins to get served. Food was piling up on the slide and going cold. Till person was having to deal with drinks and fries. Another person was trying to put together the order but was getting confused. She must have made about 4 ice creams and chucked them because no one collected it. Then have us cold chicken nuggets as they had been sitting there so long and attempted to fry them again the chip fryer! Big no No!! Fast food... heck no.... must of been 30mins by the time I got the food. Manager or supervisor eventually turned up and was very rude. Sort it out McDonald's
author: Peter Leung

text:
29.06.25. I visited McDonald's in Korea for the first time and was excited to try the food here. The service was fast and the taste was really good, which I appreciate. However, I was disappointed with the staff’s attitude.

When I politely asked which mayonnaise was used in the burger, the staff seemed unwilling to explain. Earlier, I had also asked if I could charge my phone, and the response was quite rude and impolite.

I understand they may be busy, but a little more kindness and patience would make the experience much better for customers, especially for foreigners. I hope the staff can be more courteous and helpful in the future.
author: Rayhona Abdunazarova

text: La atención horrible.Mientras hacíamos el pedido nos hizo gestos súper groseros y embolsaba la comida de malas formas, tirándola como si fuera basura de verdad . Patatas fritas súper frías y sin sabor alguno y la hamburguesa descolocada porque la tiró de malas formas en la bolsa.He viajado por el mundo y es la primera vez que tengo tan mala experiencia en un Mac Donald's.No sé si se debió a que éramos extrajeras,porque lo éramos todos y recibimos todos el mismo mal trato, menos unos coreanos que entraron al final,pero me sentí muy incómoda.En el ticket pone que me atendió Kim Min-sik
